method: Match telemetry damage curves and audio/video verified fire intervals reported by pubgstatistics.com; not an official KRAFTON export.
notes: Per-weapon pubgVersion retained; not all curves were remeasured in patch 43.1.
Linear interpolation within measured range only; no extrapolation past maxDistance.
Display RPM rounded to nearest 10; perfect timing, 4x bolt scope, MG3 990 mode defaults.
Shotgun base damage per pellet; total mode assumes all pellets hit same region.
